description: This file contains functions for generating a UAE VAT report, including data retrieval, calculations, and formatting for a report on VAT, sales, expenses, and emirates-specific data within the ERPNext system.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the VAT report, returning columns and data.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the structure of the report columns.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves and compiles report data based on filters.

methods.name: append_vat_on_sales
methods.description: Adds VAT on sales and related data to the report.

methods.name: standard_rated_expenses_emiratewise
methods.description: Calculates and appends emirate-wise standard rated expenses and VAT.

methods.name: append_emiratewise_expenses
methods.description: Appends emirate-specific expense data to the report.

methods.name: append_vat_on_expenses
methods.description: Adds VAT on expenses and other input data to the report.

methods.name: append_data
methods.description: Helper to append a data row to the report data list.

methods.name: get_total_emiratewise
methods.description: Calculates total amounts and taxes per emirate.

methods.name: get_emirates
methods.description: Returns list of emirates for report display.

methods.name: get_filters
methods.description: Builds filter conditions for sales data queries.

methods.name: get_reverse_charge_total
methods.description: Calculates total reverse charge purchase invoices.

methods.name: get_reverse_charge_tax
methods.description: Calculates total tax for reverse charge purchase invoices.

methods.name: get_reverse_charge_recoverable_total
methods.description: Calculates total recoverable reverse charge purchase invoices.

methods.name: get_reverse_charge_recoverable_tax
methods.description: Calculates total recoverable reverse charge tax.

methods.name: get_conditions_join
methods.description: Builds join conditions for purchase invoice queries.

methods.name: get_standard_rated_expenses_total
methods.description: Calculates total standard rated expenses.

methods.name: get_standard_rated_expenses_tax
methods.description: Calculates tax on standard rated expenses.

methods.name: get_tourist_tax_return_total
methods.description: Calculates total tourist tax return amount.

methods.name: get_tourist_tax_return_tax
methods.description: Calculates tax on tourist tax return.

methods.name: get_zero_rated_total
methods.description: Calculates total zero-rated sales.

methods.name: get_exempt_total
methods.description: Calculates total exempt sales.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds filter conditions for sales data queries.
